item.title: President Trump’s State of the Union Address to broadcast and livestream on South Carolina ETV and Public Radio
item.description: South Carolina ETV and Public Radio (SCETV) will broadcast and livestream coverage of President Trump’s State of the Union address on Feb. 24 at 9 p.m.

item.title: Lane Closures Tonight for Ashley River Crossing Construction
item.description: The City of Charleston, in collaboration with the South Carolina Department of Transportation and MasTec-Civil, will implement nighttime lane closures for construction on the Ashley River Crossing bridge.

item.title: Shem Creek Restaurants Announce “Crawlin’ on the Creek: Mardi Gras Edition”
item.description: Several Shem Creek waterfront restaurants are joining forces for Crawlin’ on the Creek: Mardi Gras Edition, an all-day celebration set for Saturday, Feb. 21, 2026, beginning at noon and continuing into the evening.

item.title: Mt. Joy to Perform at Credit One Stadium in June
item.description: Indie rockers Mt. Joy will perform at the Credit One Stadium on Daniel Island on Saturday, June 13 at 8 p.m. They will be joined by special guest Winyah.

item.title: Checkers adds bold NEW Clucker Sandwiches to the Menu
item.description: Checkers is adding new Clucker Sandwiches to its menu, offering guests a bold, flavorful take on a QSR classic.

item.title: Society of Bluffton Artists Launches Member-Donated Art Exhibition in Support of Capital Campaign
item.description: The Society of Bluffton Artists (SOBA) is proud to announce a special exhibition featuring donated artwork by member artists, with proceeds supporting the organization’s ongoing capital campaign fund.

item.title: The Miller Gallery Presents “Garden of Curiosities"
item.description: The Miller Gallery will present Garden of Curiosities, a playful and immersive group exhibition transforming the gallery into an imaginative garden filled with sculptural characters, quirky objects, and small, delightful surprises.
